# pg_dbml

> PostgreSQL Schema to DBML Exporter — pure SQL, zero external dependencies.

pg_dbml is a CLI tool that introspects a PostgreSQL database and exports its complete schema into DBML (Database Markup Language) format. It executes a single pure SQL query against PostgreSQL system catalogs, requiring only `psql` as a dependency. No ORMs, no drivers, no configuration files.

## Links

- [Homepage](https://pg_dbml.80.cz/)
- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/heptau/pg_dbml)
- [Installation](https://pg_dbml.80.cz/#installation)
- [Usage & Parameters](https://pg_dbml.80.cz/#usage)
- [Changelog](https://github.com/heptau/pg_dbml/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)

## Key Facts

- Language: Bash + SQL
- Requires: psql (PostgreSQL client)
- License: MIT
- Install: `brew install heptau/tap/pg-dbml` or manual clone from GitHub
- Output format: DBML (dbml.io)

## What pg_dbml exports

Across all user schemas (excluding pg_catalog and information_schema):

- Tables with fully qualified `schema.table` names
- Column names, data types (normalized: `character varying` → `varchar`, etc.)
- Primary keys, unique constraints, NOT NULL constraints
- Default values (casts stripped, clean output)
- Indexes — including composite indexes and INCLUDE columns
- Foreign key references with constraint names
- Table and column comments from PostgreSQL metadata

## Typical use cases

- Providing PostgreSQL schema as context to AI assistants and LLMs
- Generating documentation or ER diagrams via dbdiagram.io
- Schema snapshots in CI/CD pipelines
- Comparing schema structure across environments

## Quick start

```bash
brew install heptau/tap/pg-dbml
pg_dbml -d my_database
# Output: my_database.dbml
```

Or with connection URI:

```bash
pg_dbml postgresql://user:pass@localhost:5432/my_database
```
